properties.notes: Land formerly utilised for storage and distribution purposes for a nursery and landscape gardening business. After becoming surplus to these requirements the land has been identified for redevelopment. An outline consent for the whole site was initially approved (13/03785/OUT). Two detailed applications were then submitted, totalling 14 dwellings. A reserved matters permission for 8 homes on the northern parcel was granted in 2016 (15/02576/REM). A further application to build 6 additional bungalows on the reminding land to the south of the site was approved in 2018 (17/04162/FUL). Despite being covered by two separate permissions, the site essentially constitutes as a single coherent scheme. Development of 14 dwellings competed in 2018/19.
